policy: Third-party marks are used only as descriptive identifiers for compatible agents and providers. They are not Across Agents Assistant branding.
visual_policy: Official/library glyphs are not redrawn. Dark/light black-white backgrounds are project-owned UI containers used to normalize app presentation and preserve clear space.
runtime_app_icon_visual_treatment: Installed local app icons are read from the user machine and are not bundled. Codex prefers the installed OpenAI-signed Codex.app icon when present, then falls back to the bundled OpenAI glyph tile. Claude Desktop prefers the installed Claude.app or Claude Code URL Handler icon when present, then falls back to the bundled Claude glyph tile. Cursor remains fallback-only so macOS app-icon shadows and halos do not leak into the sidebar.
